source: ESPN NBA team rosters and dated injury report

report.comment: Newell underwent surgery Tuesday for a plantar plate tear in his left great toe, and he will be re-evaluated in approximately four months, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
McCollum (calf) will miss at least four weeks, per Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.
Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.
Landale (hip) is out for Friday's game against the Celtics.
Gueye (foot) is ready to begin on-court activities and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
Wagner (knee) won't be available for Friday's game against Toronto.
Traore will be re-evaluated in approximately 8-10 weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
Robinson (illness) is questionable for Friday's game against the Hawks.
Schroder (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's game the Bulls.
Allen (concussion) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Chicago.
Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.
Kalkbrenner (hip) has been ruled out for Wednesday's matchup with Chicago.
Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Smith (illness) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against Charlotte.
Powell has been diagnosed with a mild right hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated later this week.
Mobley will receive treatment and participate in rehab after the team confirmed a diagnosis of a right great toe sprain, and he'll be re-evaluated in the next 7-to-10 days.
Tomlin (back) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game against the Grizzlies.

Robinson (quadriceps) is out for Friday's game against the Bucks.
The Pistons announced Tuesday that Okorie (oblique) will miss at least two weeks, per Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com.
Detroit recalled Duren (hamstring) from the G League's Motor City Cruise on Wednesday.
Prince underwent arthroscopic right knee surgery Nov. 18 and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.
Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
Curry (abdomen) will be re-evaluated Friday after Thanksgiving, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.
Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.
Oubre is questionable for Friday's game against the 76ers due to a right hand laceration.
Nance (ankle) is questionable for Friday's game against the 76ers.
McConnell (hamstring) is questionable for Friday's game against the 76ers.
Haliburton (hamstring) was recalled from the G League's Noblesville Boom on Tuesday, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.
Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.
Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.
Reaves (heel) is questionable for Friday's game against the Spurs.
Boozer (ankle) will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Jackson underwent a procedure Wednesday to repair a broken fifth metatarsal in his left foot. He is expected to recover fully and will be re-evaluated in approximately three months.
Stewart is questionable for Friday's game against the Timberwolves due to right hip soreness.
Grant was diagnosed with a grade 1 left calf strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks.
Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Pippen (back) is out for Wednesday's game against the Clippers.
Edey (ankle) is questionable for Friday's game against the Timberwolves.

Mathurin (foot) is doubtful for Friday's game against the Clippers.
Murray (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.

Watford (ankle) is probable for Friday's game against the Clippers.
Drummond (head) is questionable for Friday's game against the Heat.

Williams (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Pacers, according to the NBA's official injury report.
Williams (back) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against Minnesota.

Castleton totaled five points (2-4 FG, 1-1 3Pt) and four rebounds in seven minutes during Tuesday's 132-116 preseason win over the Cavaliers.

Youngblood (heel) is out for Friday's game against the Warriors.

Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers Insider Sean Highkin reports.
Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

Hayes (knee) is questionable for Friday's game against the Nuggets.
